CustomField.description: Global model identifier of the Global Client generated by the Master of Clients and Groups. When the same client is identified with multiple identifiers across different applications, those local identifiers are consolidated into a new Global Client identifier. The attributes used to configure the Global Client are referred to as the Golden Record.
